extracted_decision.summary: Authorized adding HTTP transport to blowsh (an own project).
extracted_decision.rationale: blowsh is first-party, so it can be modified directly for the singleton rollout.
alternatives: Treat it as read-only like third-party MCP servers
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Enables the singleton transport; adds HTTP to a stdio-first server.
